title: shadPS4 0.15.0: official development build
summary: shadPS4 published 0.15.0 on March 17, 2026. The release record documents an official development build for the PlayStation 4 emulator project.

blocks.text: The shadPS4 project published version 0.15.0 on March 17, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: Automatically add missing hotkeys to the global input config. Fixed in Settings:InternalScreenWidth would get internalScreenHeight instead of InternalScreenWidth. Kernel.Pthreads: Remove unreachable in posix pthread mutex timedlock. Volume hotkey: show volume value, set game specific arg correctly, clamp value.
